summary: Iteration 2 - regression + new features (Excel-import + per-article SVG barcode). Backend: 12/12 NEW pytest tests PASS (test_import_and_barcode_svg.py): template .xlsx with correct 6 Dutch headers; preview rejects monteur (403), non-xlsx (400) and missing column (400); valid xlsx returns rows with per-row errors - row 4 duplicate code in file + row 5 Artikelnaam ontbreekt both correctly flagged; commit added 2 and on repeat added 0 with 2 skipped reasons; physical_stock = Hoeveelheid, exactly one 'beginvoorraad' mutation per imported article (no ontvangst), subsequent afboeken/ontvangst mutations work and update stock correctly; PUT barcode-svg rejects non-.svg filename (400) and <script> payload (400); upload succeeds, GET returns the stored svg + value + filename, DELETE unlinks SVG but keeps barcode value, GET then 404 while /api/articles/by-barcode/{value} still resolves to correct article; duplicate barcode value across articles returns 409; PATCH removing the svg-linked barcode -> 409 (business rule enforced); monteur PUT -> 403. Regression suite (test_backend_api.py) 27/32 pass; 5 pre-existing failures are stale assertions tied to removed demo data (expects >=20 articles / DB-1001 / 8712345000011 / 'glasklem') - NOT bugs. test_create_article_with_initial_stock updated: beginvoorraad instead of ontvangst (matches current PRD). On TEST-X-002 detail: article-title 'TEST Greep chroom', article-number TEST-X-002, physical stock 3, mutatiehistorie card 'Beginvoorraad +3' with note 'Beginvoorraad via Excel-import test_import.xlsx' (NO ontvangst). SVG upload sheet: pick /tmp/test_barcode.svg, suggestion chip barcode-svg-suggestion-8719999000017 appears, custom value UITBC1791541181 saved -> barcode-svg-image + barcode-svg-value visible; reload keeps svg (persistence OK). Scannen tab manual input of UITBC1791541181 opens correct article with green banner article-scan-check 'Gescande waarde ... komt overeen met de opgeslagen barcode van dit artikel'. artikel-form shows new form-name-input (Artikelnaam) + existing form-article-number-input. Monteur: /artikelen - geen Import en geen Nieuw knop; op TEST-X-002 geen barcode-svg-upload-button, geen replace/delete, geen article-edit-button; barcode-svg-section nog zichtbaar met 'Geen SVG-barcode gekoppeld' tekst (correct). No React Native red screens; only non-blocking warnings 'shadow* style props deprecated' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated'. No deprecated expo packages found.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Affects multiple styled components (does not break UI).
Non-blocking console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.

action_items: No functional fixes required. All PRD items (Excel-import preview/commit/template, beginvoorraad semantics, per-article SVG upload + persistence + unique value, scan match banner, RBAC for monteur, form-name-input) verified end-to-end.
Optional cleanup (non-blocking): replace deprecated RN Web 'shadow*' style props with 'boxShadow' and props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents to silence console warnings.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py apply_initial_stock uses client_request_id='init-{art.id}' which is good for idempotency (prevents double beginvoorraad on retry).
server.py import_commit re-runs validate_import_rows just before insert - correct to re-check existing_codes in case of concurrent imports; still uses $addToSet + unique index for final guarantee.
PATCH-cannot-remove-svg-linked-barcode is enforced server-side (409) which is good; UI should also hide that barcode from the removable chips when linked to the SVG to avoid confusing error.

SVG storage path /{STORAGE_APP_NAME}/barcodes/{article_id}/{uuid}.svg is immutable per upload; previous file is replaced in Mongo meta but not deleted from object storage - minor orphaning on 'Vervangen'.
